Text: Seems we're just about ready to start building the habitation modules! Gather up before construction begins so we can get underway immediately!

Excellent news for those who enjoy the comforting security of walls and ceilings─the habitation modules are complete!<<key>>We're set up amidst the city ruins and its greenery, so it'll be just like living in the old civilization.<<key>>Reportingway also has an article up in the Infrastructure Index if you're craving a deeper dive on the new dwellings!
We are presently gathering materials for a Cosmoliner circuit in the central city. Complete stellar missions to assist in our efforts!
Cosmoliner circuit construction in the central city is nearing completion! We'll all be surfing through the skies in no time!

The Cosmoliner in the central city is up and running!<<key>>No more trudging on foot as you zip airily around the city center and its surrounds! And for those traveling further afield, fear not─future extensions are already on the drawing board!<<key>>Read Reportingway's latest article on the subject in the Infrastructure Index!
Who likes stable energy production and a clean water supply? I mean, probably everyone, right? Help provide supplies for our infrastructure by completing stellar missions!
The plans for construction of the energization station are coming along nicely! We'll be starting any moment now, so stay tuned for further instructions!

And we're powered up! With all the aether abound in this star, our energy concerns are no more! Construction of the hydrofication station is up next, so keep your eyes on the Infrastructure Index to find out when we'll begin.

The hydrofication station is complete and we now have water in abundance!<<key>>And thanks to your generous assistance, we've also established another on-site lab for Dylise! It's the place to go when your curiosity about Auxesia demands to be satisfied!<<key>>If you desire even more words on the subject, Reportingway has posted a summary of our progress in the Infrastructure Index.

We think the spirally tower in the Netroot Radius is critical to running the city's systems! Right now, our best and brightest are attempting to restore its functionality and perform a full analysis.<<key>>But it seems the uncontrolled overgrowth is choking the flow of energy throughout the city, and we're going to need more than gardening shears to trim it down!<<key>>Hop on those stellar missions and gather the supplies we need to clear these pernicious plants!
Just how massive can the Sprouting Towerling become? We're about to find out! Work on the structure's revivification is set to begin any moment!

The Sprouting Towerling is towering sproutingly! And the surrounding foliage no longer flourishes with such menacing vigor!<<key>>This has allowed our research team to begin their analysis into the spire's purpose, which promises to help launch the next stage of our explorations!<<key>>But don't take my word for it─read Reportingway's! His latest entry can be found in the Infrastructure Index!

Plans are in motion to connect the Sprouting Towerling to the Timberlodge network, thereby improving aetherial information analysis efficiency... Sounds exciting!<<key>>We'll need to reconfigure the lodge's systems to accommodate this endeavor, and every completed stellar mission will provide us with a crucial source of supplementary materials!
If we're to have any hope of reaching the Sprouting Towerling, we'll need to expand our facilities in the Timberlodge. Be ready to receive further instructions on when work begins!

Upgrades! The network reconfiguration is completed, and we've succeeded in linking the Sprouting Towerling to the Timberlodge!<>As we analyze all the juicy aetherial information left behind by the Voyagers, we can look forward to a deeper understanding of this astounding city!<>Should you wish to deepen your understanding, refer to Reportingway's newest piece in the Infrastructure Index!

After linking the Sprouting Towerling to the Timberlodge, subsequent data analysis revealed the existence of another tower in the northwest of the city center!<<key>>As the very road needed to reach it is presently impassable, however, we'll be bringing in a newly designed logging machine!<<key>>With your stellar cooperation (yes, I mean missions), we'll carve a path to Sylvan Stacks in no time!
Once we secure a route to the Sunning Towerling, we'll finally be able to reach the structure in the northwest sector of Sylvan Stacks! Stay alert for further instructions before work begins!

A team has arrived at the Sunning Towerling in Sylvan Stacks to further our growing understanding of the city!<<key>>Based upon her scholarly intuition, Dylise suspects this second tower fills a separate role from the first. Could this mean the towers in each sector provided a different urban function?<<key>>Open up the Infrastructure Index to read Reportingway's thoughts on the subject!

According to our intrepid research team, the approach we used with the Sprouting Towerling will avail us naught with Sunning...<<key>>The Oizys ores identified in the immediate vicinity, however, are a telling clue as to the materials we might need to activate the spire!<<key>>Get cracking with those stellar missions, and let's see its big light shine!
The Sunning Towerling will soon tower above us all! Be ready to work once revivification commences!

The Sunning Towerling shines again! Added to the data we're gleaning from Sprouting, we can expect a huge leap forward in our analysis efforts!<<key>>The rampant greenery appears to have settled around this spire too, giving rise to a theory that the towers are responsible for controlling the plants' abnormal growth...<<key>>As usual, Reportingway has more to say in the pages of the Infrastructure Index.
The Cosmoliner is to be extended to Sylvan Stacks! Make a much-appreciated material contribution through the magic of stellar missions!
The Cosmoliner extension to Sylvan Stacks is on schedule for completion! If long walks are not your style, just wait a bit and you can save your aching soles!

The Cosmoliner now extends to Sylvan Stacks! Thanks to everyone who pitched in with their stellar contributions.<<key>>Ah, how easy it is now to glide right up to the Sunning Towerling! This means less time traveling and more time researching!<<key>>Check out the Infrastructure Index to read up on Reportingway's report!

The efficient transportation of analysis samples to Etheirys is one of our top priorities. So the next item on the agenda is a cosmoport upgrade!<<key>>And we all know what that means: stellar mission madness!
The cosmoport is in need of a little brushing up, and we've finally solidified our plans for maintenance! Stand by for more details!

Feast your eyes upon our new and improved cosmoport! Marvel at the quantity of research materials we can now send to Etheirys all in one go!<<key>>And have you seen our completed shielding? Not only will it reduce interference with our takeoffs and landings, but also enhance our interstellar communications!<<key>>Take a peek into the Infrastructure Index where Reportingway covers our progress!

Our persistent scientific delving into the two towers has revealed a third structure to the southwest, in the Stratostone Stand!<<key>>The research team's plan to reach this “Rooting Towerling” is currently under development! Carry out stellar missions and bring them the resources we need to move forward!
Securing a route to the Rooting Towerling will bring us that much closer to our goals! We hope to have plenty of eager paws to help us when work begins!

As per the plan, we've reactivated the old drones and harnessed their vegetative control to build a new bridge! The Rooting Towerling is ours to analyze!<<key>>Did this region consume energy at an accelerated pace? The presence of Oizys ore in the area seems to suggest so!<<key>>Reportingway has posted his collected musings on the subject in the Infrastructure Index!

The team theorizes that the Rooting Towerling can be restored by a method similar to the one used with Sunning!<<key>>Thus shall we employ the indicolite on hand to supply energy to the spire!<<key>>To your stellar missions, people! Locate! Acquire! Contribute!
Next we will restore the Rooting Towerling to all its glory! Stand by for more details of the project!

With the Rooting Towerling safely activated, we have now restored all three of the spires that encompass the city center!<<key>>Soon we'll be approaching this star's pulsing heart! Even the drooping foliage around the tower has perked up in anticipation!<<key>>Meanwhile, you can occupy yourself with Reportingway's latest Infrastructure Index entry!
We're extending the Cosmoliner to the Stratostone Stand! But don't “stand” around waiting for it to happen─stellar missions are calling your name!
The Cosmoliner extension to the Stratostone Stand is on schedule for completion! “Stand” by for the next announcement!

Thanks to everyone's stellar efforts, the Cosmoliner extension to the Stratostone Stand is now complete!<<key>>The Rooting Towerling is now just a short ride away, meaning more time for figuring out the spire's function!<<key>>Reportingway has the scoop in the Infrastructure Index!

They say the heart of the network which wraps around this entire star is housed in the soaring tower in the Core Shroud to the north!<<key>>We'll need specialized machinery to reach its lofty heights, and the mech hangar must be refurbished to accommodate these new vehicles!<<key>>Grab some stellar missions and mech it happen!
We can never have too many mechs, so we're going full speed ahead on our hangar expansion plans! More details will be announced soon!

The mech hangar is remade, and we'll be filling it with amazing new mechs!<<key>>And while we had the tools out, we also upgraded a slew of base facilities to improve day-to-day life for all initiative participants!<<key>>Look for Reportingway's latest piece in the Infrastructure Index for details!

Current research results suggest that repairing “Grandma Laurel,” the network's core mechanism, is the key to unlocking the mysteries of Auxesia!<<key>>As such, the next step for the initiative will involve restoring this facility, as well as expanding the Cosmoliner circuit to Grandma's tower in the northeastern reaches!<<key>>All contributions from stellar missions will bring us closer to this goal!
The flora of the Core Shroud could use an infusion of formula! Anyone eager to contribute should await for further instructions!

The Cosmoliner now extends to Grandma Laurel on the upper level! Time to get down to some serious research!<<key>>With the energy grid also reaching to Grandma's heights, we can finally enter the domed sanctum!
Have a peek in the Infrastructure Index, where Reportingway has posted his own explanatory paragraphs!

This is it, folks! We're poised to restore the star-spanning Family Netroot and reboot the core system inside Grandma Laurel!<<key>>The aetherial stagnation we've seen caused by unchecked overgrowth and wilting greenery has disrupted the vegetal circuitry even here!<<key>>But that's nothing an influx of resources provided by stellar missions won't fix! Take up your tools, everyone!
Soon we will see just what Grandma Laurel is fully capable of! Any who would contribute to this momentous undertaking should stand by for instructions!

Rejoice! Auxesia's core system is up and running! We're but a single step away from understanding the full story of this star and the Voyagers who resided here!<<key>>Even as we speak, Dylise and her diligent team are making the final preparations to untangle the aetherial flow and revive the most magical mechanisms!<<key>>We couldn't have made it this far without your tireless cooperation, so take a breather and read Reportingway's assessment in the Infrastructure Index! You've earned it!

Thanks to everyone's critical contributions, our expedition on Auxesia has been a resounding success!<<key>>The Cosmic Exploration Initiative will forge ever onwards, in search of new galactic secrets to uncover! To many more stars and beyond!
Your mission objective is to clear the area of all dangerous plant life. The toxic pollen these weeds produce is harmful to everything in their immediate vicinity.
Our geological survey concluded that this plant species is less than five centuries old, meaning the city's technology was not designed for its eradication.
Your mech, however, has been equipped with magitek claws adapted for that very purpose. They should slice through this fatal flora with grim efficiency!
No trace of poisonous growth can be allowed to remain. Commence felling!
Welcome to our ground support volunteers! Your task is to incinerate the smaller weeds.
Deposit all collected plant ash at the field scanners to aid in mech operations!
Camouflaged growths detected. Mech pilots, destroy these new targets!
Maintain pace. We're on target to clear the field within our projected mission time frame!
Weed eradication is proceeding apace, but pollen levels are rising! Some unknown factor is at play here...
Weed eradication is ninety percent complete! One last push, people!
Operation successful! The toxic growths have been completely eradicated thanks to all our dedicated pilots and ground support personnel!
Operation failed... All personnel, return to your regular duties.
An infestation of toxic pollen-spewing weeds has taken over Highwood Estates. We fear an adverse effect on existing vegetation, not to mention any initiative members working nearby.
We will be mobilizing warmachina developed by our Garlean allies to neutralize this botanical threat.
Consider this your call to arms. Prospective pilots, submit your applications!
Exercise caution! New growths detected in the vicinity are displaying actively hostile behavior!
New hostile growths detected! An instinctive threat response...? All personnel, watch your step!
Hostile plants are temporarily neutralized! Mech pilots, seize this opportunity to fell the aggressive specimens!
As stated, your mission will be to promote the growth of an ancient plant species crucial for environmental stability.
In the millennia since the Voyagers disappeared, the urban center's steady decline has visibly impeded their botanical systems.
To combat this dilemma, we've stocked your mech with a custom growth formula. Use it liberally to accelerate the plants' natural sublimation cycle!
These plants must be encouraged to complete their growth and surrender their accumulated aether! Commence spraying!
Welcome to our ground support volunteers! Your mission is to energize the dwarf plants with a custom growth formula!
The tanks we've positioned in the area contain extra reserves of this alchemical solution! Resupply your sprayers as needed!
Satisfactory aether diffusion levels confirmed. A “sublime” effort from all personnel!
Operation failed... All personnel, return to your regular duties.
The ancient plant species found at Blossomingway Beds was cultivated to spontaneously sublimate and scatter its aether upon reaching full maturity.
Unfortunately, however, the degradation of city functions has stunted the plants' growth cycle, thus delaying this vital ecological process.
We are now recruiting personnel to assist with an accelerated growth directive. Prospective pilots, submit your applications!
We're making good progress! A significant percentage of plant specimens have undergone sublimation!
Right, let's bring in more supply drops. Pilots, don't be shy about picking up those formula restocks!
We are now ninety percent to our sublimation goal! Just a few more plants to go!
The next set of supply drops is on the way! Pilots, keep an eye out and be sure to refill your mechs!
Sublimation of all plant specimens is complete! Excellent work!
Attention, all pilots. Drones will soon be making supply drops in the operation zone!
Collect these formula cases to fill your secondary canisters, which can be used to activate your wide-area diffusion armaments!
Fill up at the formula tanks to enable your sprayer's wide-angle secondary firing mode!
Formation of auroral flare patterns detected. All personnel are instructed to remain vigilant and expect irregular conditions.
Incoming floracane detected. Mechanical malfunctions are expected beyond the influence of the rainbow crystal. All hands are advised to exercise caution!
Oizys plant life has infested the survey zone! Stray seeds must have accompanied our cargo from that star and had their growth here accelerated by auroral radiation.
We cannot predict how this might affect native vegetation. Make haste to the isle west of the Timberlodge and assist with the invasive plants' eradication!
We also have reports of a second auroral flare-related incident.
Motes formed of an inexplicable aetherial luminescence were witnessed rising from a pond in the west of the Emerald Nervure.
A study of this glowing enigma may lead to new research opportunities and applications. Join the team on-site and assist with their investigation.
With the abundance of water samples now collected, investigations into the luminescent pond are well in hand. The survey team thanks all volunteers for their assistance.
We are on target to completely eradicate the invasive Oizys plant species and predict no further adverse effects on native environs. Your swift response is greatly appreciated!
Red alert! Exposure to auroral flares has augmented the growth of invasive spores from Sinus Ardorum!
The lunar fungi's impact on the environment is uncertain─thus, we have ordered their immediate incineration. All able hands, please join us on the Scrambling Ways posthaste!
Furthermore, we've received another report regarding the auroral flares.
Flare exposure has revealed a once-subterranean flora growth east of the Scrambling Ways. The fruits borne by these plants contain high concentrations of rare ore.
Though resources are tight, this is a prime harvesting opportunity─one we do not intend to waste. We must unearth these fruits while the auroras persist!
Thanks to one and all, our ore quota has been filled! Please submit any surplus materials to the collection point at your earliest convenience.
The invasive fungi have been exterminated. We extend our thanks to all volunteers for their timely aid!
Powerful aetheric interference from a floracane has caused a vacuum suit working on an outer isle to crash.
Additional supplies are urgently required at the crash site in the southern section of Pileus Pergola, where repair work is ongoing.
We've also received an additional report on the floracane.
A group of Loporrits in the field are suffering from an unusual, floracane-induced condition.
The aetheric petal storm appears to have filled them with the uncontrollable urge to dance. It might look fun, but their condition is serious. This party needs breaking up!
All entranced Loporrits are showing signs of improvement. Thanks to everyone's efforts, we expect them to make a full recovery.
Sufficient materials have been collected for the vacuum suit repairs─good work! Further deliveries will be gladly received.
One of our distant drone teams is facing severe floracane-induced technical issues!
Operators were able to perform a controlled landing in the vicinity of the Netroot Radius, but the repairs will require plentiful spare parts!
We've also received an additional report on the floracane.
A spongoi outbreak has been detected at Pileus Pergola, generating a heretofore unseen deluge of spores.
The outbreak likely stems from the excess aether generated by the floracane. Gather samples that we might ascertain the environmental impact of the spongoi.
Thanks to our wonderful contributors, we have secured sufficient spongoi samples!
Emergency drone repair work is proceeding admirably. Thanks to your valiant efforts, the fleet will be back up and running in no time.
This is not a drill! We call upon all personnel with the requisite skill sets to respond immediately!
We call upon all personnel with the requisite skill sets to respond immediately!
The on-site team is confident it can handle the remaining pockets of Oizys plant life. The willing and able are encouraged to head over and assist with the Emerald Nervure survey.
The survey team reports sufficient collection of luminescent water samples. Head west of the base and assist with the eradication efforts!
Excellent news─lunar fungi incineration efforts are a success! Next, we must redouble our efforts to harvest ore-rich fruit while the flare lasts.
Our rare ore stores are nearly filled to the brim. We thank our eager volunteers for their bountiful harvest! Fungi incineration is now our main priority.
Sufficient materials have been collected for the vacuum suit repairs. All available hands, assist with the Loporrit rescue efforts in the Orchidelirium!
Affected Loporrits are once again in full possession of their faculties. All available hands should focus efforts on the vacuum suit repairs!
Our drone fleet has been restored to working order! Let us now concentrate on the abundant samples to be collected at Pileus Pergola.
We now have sufficient spongoi samples to facilitate our research. No time to rest, though─there are still drones in need of repair in the Netroot Radius!
We are close to resolving the issue at hand! Stay focused and attend to your respective missions!
We thank everyone for their contributions to a safe and successful resolution! The red alert has been lifted.
A workable resolution to the current issue has been devised. The red alert is no longer in effect. Return to your posts and leave remaining tasks to initiative command.
Thanks to your contributions, we now have all the supplies we require. Volunteers are nevertheless encouraged to continue delivering surplus materials.
Our equipment uses pulses of aether to scan the area. It may be possible to increase the intensity and stun the plants into inactivity...
Attention, ground support! We will attempt to incapacitate the hostile plant life using augmented aether pulses. Continue fueling the scanners with ash!

Slice away at irregular leafkin and reap the rewards!
There they are! Those troublesome traps crowding our arena...
You have dominated our foes! Sally forth, my friend!
Oho? What resplendent beauty do I spy amongst the weeds? Bring me its flesh... Bring it to me!
What connection...what spirit! Those marvelous creatures clearly inspire your greater talents...
Use the garden scythe Herberin prepared for us and start hacking away!
Cleaning Stage
This is the last area we need trimmed! I-I know it's a lot to ask, but...I have every faith in you!
